title: Twirl Alternatives in 2026: Prices, Creators and Who Runs Ads
summary: Twirl alternatives compared by on-camera talent, published prices, usage rights and who runs the ads. Facts checked from each pricing page, October 2026.
body_markdown:
The best Twirl alternative depends on whether you still need a real person on camera. Our top pick is Knowlify if you want finished UGC-style ads with AI presenters instead of real creators: it delivers about 25 finished ads a week, and a person checks each one before delivery. If a real person has to be on camera, compare Trend for a batch, Insense for recurring rounds and Billo for on-demand videos. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared.


## What Twirl charges and what each plan includes


Twirl sells creator videos on five tiers. As of October 2026, its pricing page lists these figures in US dollars, although it also shows pounds and euros:


- **Self-serve:** from $325 per video, with a first purchase of at least four videos. Each video includes two formats, two revision rounds, editing, subtitles and music, and full usage rights including paid social.
- **Creative Partner:** $550 per concept development, billed monthly on a rolling basis, plus video costs.
- **End-to-End UGC:** $950 per concept development and management, billed monthly on a rolling basis, plus video costs.
- **Managed Service:** from $2,560 per campaign, based on two concepts with three variations each, with creator costs included.
- **Enterprise:** custom terms through its sales team.


Extra hooks or calls to action are listed at $80, and whitelisting is available on request with no price listed. Twirl gives a standard turnaround of 7 to 10 days and says its focus is the UK and US, with creators also in Germany, Italy, France, Spain and Australia. The examples in its price calculator do not match one another, so ask for a written quote that lists each line.

## Knowlify: our top pick for AI UGC without real creators


Knowlify is the best fit if what you want to leave behind is the work around creators: sourcing, briefing, revision rounds and a standard 7 to 10 day wait for creator videos. It makes about 25 finished ads a week, the first batch lands on day five, and a person checks every ad before delivery. The three formats are AI UGC, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials, so you can test creator-style hooks next to animated and commercial-style versions of the same offer.


You can take creative only or have Knowlify run your Meta campaigns end to end. Pricing is a custom quote, and if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund (terms on[the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month.


**When to pick another option:** choose a real-creator platform when the proof depends on a real customer's experience, a creator's own handle or footage of a real person using the product. An AI presenter cannot give a testimonial, and an AI presenter should never claim to have used the product.


## Real-creator platforms: Trend, Billo and Insense


**Trend** sells creator content through prepaid credits. As of October 2026, its pricing page lists $550 for up to six videos and $3,872 for up to 56, with full licensing and distribution rights. Credits expire after 12 months, and the video counts assume the lowest creator tier. Trend suits a defined batch when you already have the brief.


**Billo** starts at $99 a video, with creator pay, two revisions and usage rights included, according to its pricing explainer. Its managed service starts at $2,000 a month, billed monthly in advance, and[Billo's homepage](https://billo.app/) cites more than 5,000 vetted creators and partnership ads from creator handles. Ask whether the managed fee includes video costs before you compare totals.


**Insense** sells a managed service at $3,500 per round of eight videos, with creator costs, raw footage, two revisions and full digital usage rights included. A round carries a three-month commitment. Insense also runs a creator platform, so confirm which product a quote covers.
